study: Final-QA v2 multimodal paired-history selective gate development

roles.development_frame: previously inspected Final-QA Validation reused as development only

case_partitions.gate_calibration_rule: remaining cases in the 170-case selection partition

source_gate.policy: retain the common answer when sources agree; classify only disagreements

selection.tie_break: simpler model, then higher image-only retention

required: question-level exact answer-set accuracy exceeds image-only
option micro-F1 difference is at least -0.001
supported-label macro-F1 difference is at least -0.005
history is used for at least one disagreement
the selected method exceeds its shuffled-pair counterpart
development_holdout_go_rule.next_step_after_go: replace oracle historical labels with report-derived structured facts before any confirmation protocol

boundary: This remains an oracle-payload development experiment because historical Rad-ReStruct labels are derived from reports. It tests whether observable multimodal relevance can select useful paired history without new MedGemma inference. It is not clinical validation, external validation, or confirmation; Final-QA Test remains uninstantiated and inaccessible.
